programme.title: Dream Islands of Europe: Lanzarote and Fuerteventura
programme.desc: The film presents the two Canary Islands Lanzarote and Fuerteventura. Lanzarote has a rich culture in addition to a volcanic landscape: the film accompanies a ceramic artist, an instrument maker, shows architecture by César Manrique and a camel breeder. On Fuerteventura, in addition to livestock farming and the operation of traditional grain mills, nature conservation plays a major role: islanders are committed to preserving the sand dunes, and there is a turtle hatchery. On Lanzarote, countless volcanic eruptions have formed a bizarre lunar landscape. It is a great challenge for the inhabitants to extract the cultivation of food from the karstic, dry soil. And yet they even manage to produce wine. Protected by thousands of small depressions that act as water reservoirs, they grow vines on porous volcanic rock.

programme.title: Germany's Wild Reservoirs
programme.desc: One of the smallest dams in the Bergisches Land is the Panzertalsperre, with an area of just four-and-a-half football pitches. On the other hand, the Dhünntalsperre is the largest with the area of 660 football pitches. They all transform a stretch of flowing water into still and stagnant water. As a result, completely diverse ecosystems have developed there: where the dipper once dived for insect larvae, cormorants and gray herons now fish and swans and coots cavort. In recent summers, even greater challenges have emerged: the effects of climate change - from extreme drought to destructive floods. On a smaller scale, a rather industrious dam master is operating flood protection: The Beaver. However, the water masses of the Wupper tore away half of his majestic timber castle - and the four young beaver kids were not seen again afterwards. Have they survived the flood? Not everyone can cope with the constant change in the dams, but they still remain an important wonder of engineering for many: for us humans as well as for a number of animals. By combining water management, ecological requirements and tourism a worthwhile goal is possible: Because for the Bergisches Land, its dams are among the most valuable and popular infrastructures that the region has to offer.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: As contrasting as the landscapes of the 15th meridian east, so different are its animal inhabitants. What are the living conditions like in the heat of the Namibian Damaraland, in Lusatia or on the coast of Norway? Which challenges do elephants, whales or kingfishers have to master together with their companions from north to south?

programme.title: Designer
programme.desc: Dre has aspirations of making it big in the cannabis industry, but when his perceived star plant dies, his hopes and dreams start to fade. He finds himself and his 2 buddies embark on a wild adventure with their sights set on the components to make the strain of all strains of cannabis.

programme.title: Kingdom Men
programme.desc: Pastor Gerald’s job is on the line if he doesn’t increase the attendance of the men in the church. He decides to have a men’s retreat hoping it will fix everything. Little did he know that he’s in for the fight of his life. He realizes God didn’t call him to increase the men at the church but help them.

programme.title: Keisha
programme.desc: Keisha always had a problem finding a decent job in her community. Financial hardship gets worse for her and her son after her grandmother dies and only leaves behind a Bible. Struggling to take care of her son and pay bills she turns to a job at a strip club. It's all to get a new life in a new city and away from the blackmailing child protective services agent. What sacrifices will she make for her and her son?

programme.title: Flew'd Out
programme.desc: Tiara is an up and coming social media influencer after going viral for posting a mans reaction online after denying him sex. In an attempt to grow her online profile, she accepts a date from a man named Josiah for an out of town excursion. Over time, Josiah's intentions become more elaborate, deranged, and sinister. Will Tiara make it out alive?

programme.title: Fall Semester
programme.desc: Kid Kypree is a college student with dreams and ambitions of becoming the next great stand-up comic. One night he gets invited to a party hosted by his old friend Bo that thrusts him into a whirlwind of opportunities and challenges that will test his friendships, resolve, and his sense of humor. He will soon discover that success comes with its own set of comedic twists and turns!

programme.title: Fist of Vengeance
programme.desc: Ciara Johnson is struggling with life after the death of her father in a local martial arts gym. To preserve her father’s legacy, Ciara is determined to win the regional Wushu Regional championship, and to keep the art alive in her father’s memory. However, she discovers a secret operation that is connected to her father’s death. Witness the showdown between legacy, and the new school of martial arts.

programme.title: Clutch
programme.desc: Detectives Clutch and Angel navigate a criminal underworld with the help of three women, whom Clutch is familiar with, to solve the disappearance of a group of women. Their investigations take them deeper into unknown and even more corrupt places in the underworld, that are worse than they thought.

programme.title: Reality TV Murders
programme.desc: In the world of reality TV, Chasity Safire is a household name and has been the star of the hugely popular reality TV show “Diva’s Doing it” for the past 5 years. When one of the castmates is found dead, the women become suspects and we discover that some of the women would literally kill to be famous.

programme.title: Finders Keepers
programme.desc: Jaylin is a struggling single father trying to support his children and make ends meet. One day he comes upon a box of pills and tries to sell them for the cash. Until thugs approach him, and now a simple gamble, becomes life threatening.

programme.title: Women of the Jury
programme.desc: A man is on trial accused of murder of two young black men, and twelve women are called to serve on the jury. After deliberation, one juror is convinced the man is not guilty, while the majority claims he is guilty. A conversation takes place consisting of arguments, alliances, and near violence. What will the verdict be?

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: Karmen, a successful businesswoman is secure and thriving in every part of her life, except for love. She downloads a dating app and seems to have found Mr. Right in Jermaine, but her best friends warn her that he might be a scammer. As Karmen falls deeper, she slowly falls victim to a network of lies and deceit, that could cost her life.

programme.title: Something Old
programme.desc: With her wedding days away, Kara agrees to meet her ex, Malik, for what she swears is just one last goodbye. But Malik isn’t looking for closure—he wants her back, and he’s not taking no for an answer. What starts as a simple meetup at a hotel turns into a dangerous game of obsession and control. As Kara’s fiancé Jordan uncovers the truth with help from her maid of honor, time’s running out.

programme.title: Rage: Kill or Be Killed
programme.desc: Jackie “Labrae” Robinson dominates Houston’s unsanctioned boxing circuit—until he comes face-to-face with the one opponent, he never imagined fighting: his personal hero, legendary champion Theo Barnes. However, Theo is a haunted man dealing with his own demons and an advanced case of CTE. A first meeting quickly escalates into an all-out brawl, making the stakes of two champion fighters that much higher.

programme.title: Victoria
programme.desc: Victoria moves from out of town into the poor inner city of New York with her father, the neighborhood drug dealer. She goes on a journey seeking answers, justice, and revenge after her father was murdered by local competition. In the process of her revenge, Victoria realizes that she doesn't want to live the lifestyle that she is living before it becomes too late.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Wasserknappheit wird in vielen Regionen der Erde zu einem immer größeren Problem. Die jüngste Entdeckung eines riesigen Grundwasserleiters im Gestein vor der US-amerikanischen Küste könnte eine große Hoffnung für die Menschheit sein.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Die Entdeckung eines Dinosaurierfossils, das so gut erhalten ist, dass es die Struktur, die Muster und die Farben eines prähistorischen Riesen zeigt. Entdecken Sie eine brandneue Spezies, die in der späten Jura- und in der Kreidezeit lebte.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Der Tyrannosaurus Rex ist bekannt als der König der Dinosaurier – aber wie begann seine Herrschaft? Hier kommt Moros Intrepidus ins Spiel, ein 80 Kilo schwerer, hirschgroßer Vorfahre des T-Rex.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.sub-title: Auf der Suche nach der Dino-DNA
programme.desc: Könnte ein 75 Millionen Jahre alter Dinosaurierschädel, der seit über 20 Jahren in einem Museum liegt, die allererste von Menschen entdeckte Dinosaurier-DNA enthalten? Ein internationales Team von Wissenschaftlern versucht das Geheimnis zu lüften.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Löwen mögen als die Könige des Dschungels bekannt sein, aber es waren Säbelzahnkatzen, die über Amerika herrschten. Neue Fossilfunde werfen ein Licht auf das gewalttätige Leben dieser mysteriösen Spezies.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Durch die Untersuchung zahlloser Megalodon-Zähne aus der ganzen Welt sind die Wissenschaftler zu dem Schluss gekommen, dass „Meg“ seine gigantischen Ausmaße erreichen konnte, indem er schon früh damit begann, Fleisch zu fressen – im Mutterleib.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Vor 65 Millionen Jahren schlug ein riesiges Weltraumgestein auf der Erde ein und verursachte das Äquivalent eines nuklearen Winters, der alle Dinosaurier tötete. Jetzt glaubt ein Team von Wissenschaftlern, dass es einen Zeugen der Katastrophe gab.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Lange ging man davon aus, dass der Mensch Nordamerika vor etwa 15.000 Jahren als letzten Kontinent besiedelte. Neue Funde deuten auf eine frühere Besiedlung hin, möglicherweise über Routen, die heute tief unter dem Meer begraben sind.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Wie lange dauert es, bis sich das Leben nach einem großen Massenaussterben erholt? Wissenschaftler finden in Fossilien im norwegischen Svalbard überraschende Erkenntnissen über die Geschichte unserer Erde.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.sub-title: Tasmanischer Tiger: Comeback aus dem Labor?
programme.desc: Vor fast einem Jahrhundert wurde der Tasmanische Tiger vom Menschen ausgerottet. Nun wollen ihn Genetiker wieder zum Leben erwecken.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Archäologen und Genetiker enthüllen überraschende Details über eine geheimnisvolle Zivilisation, die vor den Inkas Südamerika bewohnte. Nur wenige haben von den Chachapoya gehört, einem Volk, das als Wolkenkrieger bekannt ist.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Der Ausbruch des Vesuvs im Jahr 79 v. Chr. ist vor allem wegen der Zerstörung der Stadt Pompeji weltberühmt. Doch auch eine nahegelegene römische Siedlung namens Herculaneum fiel dem Vulkan zum Opfer, wurde aber weniger stark zerstört.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Vor 66 Millionen Jahren löste ein Asteroideneinschlag auf Yucatán das Dinosaurier-Massenaussterben aus. Angesichts von 700.000 Asteroiden stellt sich die Frage, was passiert, falls so etwas erneut geschieht.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Ist es denkbar, dass es in unserem Sonnensystem einen Planeten gibt, von dem wir noch nichts wissen? Vielleicht sogar mehrere? Neue Erkenntnisse deuten darauf hin, dass es einen 9. Planeten, oder auch Planet X genannt, tatsächlich geben könnte.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.sub-title: Das schwarze Loch in unserer Galaxie
programme.desc: Für das 'Event Horizon Telescope' verbanden Astronomen weltweit Radioteleskope und fotografierten das supermassereiche Schwarze Loch im Zentrum der Milchstraße. Sagittarius A* ist über vier Millionen Mal massereicher als die Sonne.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.sub-title: Auf der Suche nach Leben: Der Mars-Rover Perseverance
programme.desc: 2020 schickt die NASA den Mars-Rover Perseverance auf die Mission herauszufinden, ob es früher Leben auf dem Roten Planeten gab. Begleitet vom Mini-Helikopter Ingenuity soll er Spuren mikrobiellen Lebens finden.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Die Landung von „Perseverance“ auf dem Mars ist historisch: Spannung, jahrelange Planung und bahnbrechende Technik, inklusive des ersten Mars-Helikopters.

programme.title: Breakthrough

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED

programme.title: Dreamcars

programme.title: Dreamcars

programme.title: Mythos Tourist Trophy Teil 2

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: São os carros mais rápidos e emocionantes do mundo, construídos para velocidades além da imaginação, carros super esportivos da Ferrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, Pagani e Porsche. programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin

programme.title: Porsche Techart Grand GT

programme.title: Streetwise

programme.title: Perfect Ride

programme.title: Streetwise

programme.desc: Der Mini Cooper S ist ein Beispiel für die steigende Beliebtheit von kompakten, aber sehr leistungsstarken Stadtautos. Wir haben das Trendmodell der BMW-Marke mit dem sportlichen Ford Fiesta ST und dem S1 von Audi verglichen.

programme.title: Supercars

programme.title: Supercars

programme.title: Tuning

programme.desc: É um ícone, o carro esportivo mais vendido no mundo: o Chevrolet Corvette. O "Vette" já existe há 60 anos. Nenhum outro carro esporte se destaca tanto por seu estilo americano como o Corvette. O Corvette pertence aos EUA como a Estátua da Liberdade. O segredo de seu sucesso: um grande motor, muita potência e um design excitante. Saiba mais sobre o fascinante Chevrolet Corvette.

programme.title: Go Green
programme.desc: Die Automobil-Branche wandelt sich gerade komplett: Fahrzeuge entwickeln sich zu autonom fahrenden, voll vernetzten Digital-Devices. Die Verkehrssicherheit soll sich stark verbessern. Aber wie funktionieren Assistenz-Systeme eigentlich? Und wie sicher sind selbstfahrende PKW? MOTORVISION schaut Ingenieuren von Daimler über die Schulter - kurz vor dem Launch der neuen S-Klasse im Herbst 2017.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: 50 anos da Porsche 911 e 60 anos da Chevrolet Corvette. Duas lendas, dois carros de sonho com duas filosofias opostas.

programme.title: Go Green
programme.desc: Aboard one of the world's biggest cruise liners, we show how broadband internet on the high seas works, visit the control center of the SES' satellite fleet and take a peek at a test aircraft.

programme.title: Concorso d'Eleganza at Lake Como
programme.desc: Lake Como is home to a very special classic car meeting: the Concorso d'Eleganza. For decades, the rich and beautiful have met here with their beautiful and valuable cars - the unique classics of automobile history.

programme.title: Wanderer Stromlinie Spezial
programme.desc: Founded in 1885, the Wanderer-Werke AG was one of the three biggest German car manufacturing companies at the time of WWII. The three remaining original Wanderer Stromlinie Spezial racing cars were lost in the turmoil of the war, but Audi ordered specialist Werner Zinke to create replicas of these three iconic classic cars.

programme.title: Go Green
programme.desc: Moderne LKW bieten neue Technologien und Funktionen, die das Fahren einfacher und effizienter machen sollen. Wir haben den schwedischen Hersteller Volvo Trucks besucht und einen Blick auf die Produktion deren neuer Automatisierungssysteme geworfen.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.sub-title: Traccao as quatro rodas em vagoes de estacao
programme.desc: Os vagões de estação são geralmente considerados como carros familiares ou apenas veículos com muitos porões de carga. Mas o Skoda Octavia, o Opel Insignia Country Tourer, o Subaru Outback, o Audi S4 allroad quattro e o Seat Leon x-perience querem ser mais do que isso. Seu visual offroad atrai o aventureiro interno e sua tração 4x4 proporciona a tração certa em terreno acidentado. Nem sempre tem que ser um SUV.

programme.title: Go Green
programme.desc: Saubere und sichere Mobilität ist eine der großen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit. Bezahlbar, nachhaltig, komfortabel und rund um die Uhr erhältlich soll es sein. Das sind große Anforderungen, die aber auch Innovationen begünstigen. Motorvision stellt vor, wie die Zukunft in Sachen Personen und Warentransport aussieht.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Neste episódio, damos uma olhada em alguns dos exemplares mais extremos do mundo offroad: um monster truck Fiat Panda cujos pneus têm um diâmetro de 1,5 metros, um Ford Raptor com 600 hp, uma conversão de um Mercedes G-class Edition da ORC, um Volkswagen Touareg R-Line modificado da JE Design, um Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT8, o carro-chefe da marca, e o Fiat Panda Cross.

programme.title: Go Green
programme.desc: Verbraucherinnen und Verbraucher können heute zu jeder Tages- und Nachtzeit online einkaufen und erwarten, dass alles pünktlich ankommt. Doch wie funktioniert das alles so reibungslos, sicher und pünktlich? Wie meistert die Logistikbranche solche Herausforderungen?

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Na Lexus, a divisão de veículos de luxo da Toyota, a última tendência foi para formas angulares e uma aparência mais agressiva. Com seu design extravagante, o NX200t definitivamente se destaca. A Infiniti, divisão de luxo da Nissan, é mais conservadora a esse respeito. O QX30 apresenta um design clássico do Infiniti com um capô curvo e uma aparência energética. Além disso: o SUV Mazda CX-3 da cidade.

programme.title: Go Green
programme.desc: Mobilität ist eines der großen Themen unserer Zeit. Überall werden die diversesten Verkehrsmittel genutzt. Wie gehen Mobilitätsexperten mit dieser Entwicklung um? Ein gutes Beispiel dafür ist "versteckte Hightech" wie Beschichtung und 3D-Druck.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Três irmãos da mesma plataforma de produção Volkswagen: o Skoda Kodiaq oferece espaço para sete pessoas e pontua com um preço inicial favorável, o Volkswagen Tiguan é um pouco mais caro, mas oferece uma gama mais ampla de motores e gadgets mais técnicos, e o Seat infunde o segmento SUV com a paixão espanhola.

programme.title: Go Green
programme.desc: Seit 2008 baut BMW Hybridfahrzeuge, deren Emissionen und Verbrauch um mindestens ein Drittel niedriger sind als die konventioneller Pendants. Außerdem: Kohlenstoff- und Naturfasern bei der Herstellung von Karosserie- und Innenraumteilen.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.sub-title: Classe empresarial com tracao nas quatro rodas
programme.desc: O Jaguar XF-S deve pressionar a BMW, a Audi e os outros concorrentes no segmento de classe executiva. Os britânicos querem ensinar aos melhores cães alemães o verdadeiro significado da palavra medo. A Volvo tem uma abordagem diferente. Seu S90 é cativante devido a seu design escandinavo e motores econômicos de quatro cilindros.

programme.title: Go Green
programme.desc: Wir haben versucht, den Weltrekord zu brechen, indem wir mit einem wasserstoffbetriebenen Auto, dem Hyundai Nexo, mehr als 2.000 Kilometer von Stockholm nach Paris gefahren sind. Wasserstofffahrzeuge scheinen noch ein Schattendasein zu führen.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: ORZ Veículos, uma empresa alemã especializada na produção, venda e instalação de peças e acessórios para jipes, faz com que o sonho americano fora da estrada se torne realidade para os europeus. Um bom exemplo desta abordagem é o Brute, uma versão pickup do Wrangler que tem muito pouco em comum com o modelo de produção.

programme.title: VW ID.7 - Erste Testfahrt mit dem Elektro-Passat
programme.desc: Er soll den VW Passat ins Elektro-Zeitalter führen. Der ID.7 kommt zum Marktstart in einer PRO-Variante mit 77 kWh-Batterie. Kann er den Erfolg des Wolfsburger Dauerbrenners weiterführen? Wir testen die Elektro-Limousine um Marseille in Frankreich.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Compactos e mini SUVs são perfeitos para a cidade enquanto suas capacidades off-road são menos importantes. O Seat Arona é um típico representante desta gama de modelos específicos. Outro pseudo off-roader é o Volkswagen T-Roc. O menor SUV Volkswagen pode repetir o sucesso do Volkswagen Tiguan mais vendido? Também: os concorrentes asiáticos Hyundai Kona, KIA Stonic e Toyota C-HR.

programme.title: Porsche Cayenne Turbo E-Hybrid
programme.desc: 739 PS, 950 Nm Drehmoment! Er ist der bisher stärkste Cayenne aller Zeiten. Wie performt das Porsche-SUV mit sportlichem GT-Paket auf Rennstrecke und Landstraße? Und kann sportlich gleichzeitig auch sparsam sein?

programme.title: Chris Pfeiffer analisa a BMW F 800 R
programme.desc: A BMW F 800 R é robusta e tem muito temperamento. O campeão mundial Chris Pfeiffer mostra o quanto se pode divertir com um BMW F 800 R. A sua bicicleta de trabalho é baseada na versão que pode comprar.

programme.title: Neuer Kleinster bei Volvo - Wir testen den vollelektrischen EX30.
programme.desc: „Downsizing“ bei Volvo – mit dem EX30 bringen die Schweden ein komplett neues kleines Elektro-SUV auf den Markt. Der Einstiegspreis ist verhältnismäßig günstig. Bietet der EX30 Premium-Qualität und Sicherheit zum guten Preis? Wir machen den Test.

programme.title: Audi MTM S8 Talladega R
programme.desc: O Audi S8 Plus não é de forma alguma subestimado, mas é e permanece fiel à subestimação desta série de modelos. Aqueles que querem mais poder podem obter um impulso da MTM.

programme.title: PSP New Zealand Jetsprint Championship
programme.desc: No Grupo A, Matt Hareb enfrenta o atual campeão Ollie Silverton, enquanto Rasmussen também entra na disputa. Resultados acirrados e desempenhos consistentes garantem um início de temporada emocionante.

programme.title: Mercedes-AMG S 63 E Performance
programme.desc: 802 PS, 1430 Nm Drehmoment! Der AMG S 63 E Performance ist die stärkste S-Klasse, die bisher in Serie gebaut wird. Doch wie gut gelingt der Mix aus Luxus und Sportlichkeit? Wir checken den neuen AMG in Kalifornien und blicken auf seine Historie.

programme.title: Performance-Hybride
programme.desc: Hybride mit Power erobern die Straßen. Der McLaren Artura kombiniert revolutionäre Hybridtechnologie mit Rennsport-DNA. Auch Ferrari setzt beim 296 GTB auf kombinierte Power aus Strom und Benzin. Außerdem: Mercedes S 580e und Cupra Leon Sportstourer.

programme.title: PSP New Zealand Jetsprint Championship
programme.desc: Na primeira etapa em Featherston, os Superboats roubaram a cena, quando Sam Newdick enfrentou Reuben Hoeksema em uma final espetacular. Corridas rápidas e emocionantes marcaram esse duelo intenso na abertura da nova temporada do Jetsprint.

programme.title: Kurvenräuber
programme.desc: Was ist die Essenz von Sportwagen? Leistung? Präzision? Oder das unvergleichliche Gefühl, die Straße zu beherrschen. Zum Beispiel im McLaren 600 LT, Aston Martin Vantage oder Alfa Romeo Giulia GTAm.

programme.title: Icelandic Formula Offroad
programme.desc: Em Hella começa a temporada da Icelandic Formula Off-Road. Veículos potentes enfrentam terrenos extremos e proporcionam ação espetacular, motores rugindo e os primeiros duelos emocionantes de um novo e empolgante campeonato.

programme.title: Icelandic Formula Offroad
programme.desc: A abertura da Icelandic Formula Off-Road continua com as pistas quatro a seis. Os pilotos enfrentam travessias de rios, trechos pantanosos e a prova contra o relógio na disputa pelos primeiros pontos.

programme.title: Power-Sport-Kombis
programme.desc: Power-Sport-Kombis sind Familienautos mit Sportwagen-DNA. Der Audi RS6 hat sich über Jahrzehnte vom unauffälligen Familienwagen zum technologischen Meisterwerk entwickelt. Doch auch seine Konkurrenz ist nicht zu unterschätzen.

programme.title: Porsche Panamera Sport Turismo
programme.desc: We take out the Porsche Panamera Sport Turismo for a couple of rounds

programme.title: Escape
programme.desc: Norwegen im finstersten Mittelalter: Der schwarze Tod macht auch vor der Familie der 19jährigen Stigne nicht Halt, als diese auf der Flucht zum Opfer der mörderischen Bande um die skrupellose Dagmar wird. Zwar gelingt dem Mädchen als einzige Überlebende bald die Flucht. Aber ihre Verfolger sind ebenso gnadenlos wie die unwirtliche Wildnis im hohen Norden.

programme.title: June
programme.desc: June ist von einem Dämon besessen, der die Menschheit vernichten will.

programme.title: Das Duell in der verbotenen Stadt
programme.desc: China zur Zeit der Ming-Dynastie. Das Reich befindet sich in Unruhe, an allen Ecken intigrieren die unterschiedlichsten Interessengruppen mal mit, mal gegen das Kaiserhaus. Um den gefürchteten Outlaw und Bandenchef Saimoon, auch bekannt als "Gott des Schwertes", dingfest zu machen, entsendet der junge Kaiser seinen besten Mann: Dragon 9. Der jedoch kann den Gesuchten auch erst einmal bloß dazu überreden, sich einem Duell zu stellen. Dieser Kampf, an dem auch Yip Ku-sing, "der fliegende Himmelskämpfer", teilnehmen soll, wird dem Wunsch des Kaisers gemäß mitten in Peking stattfinden - direkt über den Dächern der verbotenen Stadt, beobachtet nur von acht ausgesuchten Zeugen, deren Auswahl Dragon 9 obliegt. Der befürchtet eine Fall...

programme.title: Das Urteil
programme.desc: Bei einem schweren Verkehrsunfall verliert Anwalt McClain seine Frau und seine beiden Söhne. Er selbst überlebt. Doch sein Dasein erscheint ihm nun völlig sinnlos. Aber dann übernimmt er den Fall eines jungen Mannes, der wegen Mordes zum Tod verurteilt werden soll. Während er vor Gericht für das Leben seines Klienten kämpft, findet er selbst allmählich ins Leben zurück. Dabei hilft ihm auch die verständnisvolle Anna, eine kompetente Psychologin und Seelsorgerin, die vor Jahren selbst einen schweren Verlust verarbeiten musste. Mit ihrer Hilfe erkennt Mac schließlich, dass Gott noch einen Plan für sein Leben hat.

programme.title: The Last King - Der Erbe des Königs
programme.desc: Im Jahr 1206 wütet in Norwegen der Bürgerkrieg. Der unehelich geborene Sohn des Königs, wird von zwei Männern bewacht und behütet, bis er sein Erbe antreten kann.

programme.title: Miss Viborg
programme.desc: In einer dänischen Kleinstadt treffen wir zwei Generationen von Frauen. Die 61-jährige Solvej und die 17-jährige Kate. Ihre Begegnung ist der Beginn einer unwahrscheinlichen Freundschaft, denn die Wunden der Vergangenheit werden aufgedeckt.

programme.title: Iceman - Der Krieger aus dem Eis
programme.desc: Martial Arts meets Mittelalter und Zurück in die Zukunft! Die vier Waisen Ying (Donnie Yen), Sao (Wang Baoqiang), Yuanlong (Simon Yam, Ip Man, Lara Croft Tomb Raider: Die Wiege des Lebens) und Niehu (Yu Kang, Ip Man 3, Dragon) wachsen zur Zeit der Ming Dynastie in einem kleinen Dorf auf. Als Elitekrieger für den Kaiser gelingt es ihnen den Anführer der japanischen Truppen töten. Auf dem Weg das Goldene Rat der Zeit zurück ins kaiserliche Reich zu bringen, wird Ying von seinen drei Freunden gewarnt. Da der mächtige General Tu Ying für den Tod seiner Familie verantwortlich macht, hat er eine Truppe in das Heimatdorf der Vier geschickt. In einem verzweifelten Kampf versucht Ying die Bewohner seines Dorfes zu retten, doch wird dabei unter einer riesigen Schneelawine begraben. 400 Jahre später: Ying ist plötzlich wieder aus dem Eis befreit und muss sich nun im Hongkong der Neuzeit zu Recht finden. Er trifft auf May (Shengyi Huang, Kung Fu Hustle , Die Jagd zum magischen Berg ), die ihn bei sich aufnimmt und ihm hilft sich in der Moderne zurechtzufinden. Er erfährt, dass er seinerzeit für einen Verrat verantwortlich gemacht wurde. Schuld sind jedoch die anderen beiden Gefrorenen, Sao und Niehu, die inzwischen ebenfalls erwacht sind und es nun auf Ying abgesehen haben, da er die Wahrheit kennt. Um das Schicksal seines Dorfes zu ändern und seinen Namen reinzuwaschen, bleibt Ying keine andere Wahl: Er muss selbst das Goldene Rat der Zeit finden und es dann benutzen...

programme.title: Dawn Rider
programme.desc: John Mason hat gerade erst seinen lange vermissten Vater wiedergetroffen, da geraten auch beide schon in einen Zugüberfall. Johns Vater wird dabei im hitzigen Gefecht erschossen und er selbst schwer verwundet. Auf einer nahe gelegenen Ranch kann er zwar wieder zu Kräften kommen, doch tatsächlich lauert hier erneut tödliche Gefahr: Der Bruder der Ranchbesitzerin ist der Kopf der Gangsterbande.

programme.title: Astral City
programme.desc: Als der Arzt Dr. André Luiz seine Augen aufschlägt, muss er erkennen, dass er tot ist. In einer bedrohlich wirkenden Wüste beginnt seine abenteuerliche Reise. Bald betritt er dort die mysteriöse Astral City, die die Einwohner als ihr Heim bezeichnen. Er scheint nicht im Himmel angekommen zu sein, sondern in einer spirituellen Dimension. Luiz ist also nicht am Ende seiner Reise angekommen, sondern vielmehr am Anfang. Ein Meisterwerk des brasilianischen Kinos voller atemberaubender Effekte!

programme.title: Schuldig bei Verdacht
programme.desc: Amerika, Anfang der 50er Jahre. McCarthys Kommunistenhatz ist in vollem Gange. Auch der Regisseur David Merrill (Robert De Niro), der vor Jahren kommunistische Treffen besuchte, soll vor einem Komitee die Namen der Kollegen nennen, die bei diesen Treffen dabei waren. Als er sich weigert, steht auch sein Name auf der schwarzen Liste. Fortan kann er nicht mehr in Hollywood arbeiten, wird vom FBI bespitzelt und erlebt, wie Freunde an der modernen Hexenjagd zerbrechen. Als er vor einem Ausschuss zur Aussage gezwungen wird, tritt er die Flucht nach vorn an und beginnt einen verzweifelten Kampf gegen eine unerbittliche Staatsmacht...

programme.title: State of Mind
programme.desc: Aus scheinbar heiterem Himmel und ohne großen Anlass ermordet Leland Fitzgerald (Ryan Gosling), Sohn des ebenso zynischen wie erfolgreichen Literaten und Alkoholikers Albert Fitzgerald (Kevin Spacey), den autistischen Bruder seiner drogensüchtigen Freundin Becky Pollard (Jena Malone). Während die Tat ihre psychologischen Spuren bei den beiden direkt betroffenen Familien hinterlässt, wittert der Psychologe, Lehrer und angehende Autor Pearl Madison (Don Cheadle) im Gefängnis die Chance auf einen Publicity-Coup.

programme.title: Die Behandlung
programme.desc: Ein schockierendes Verbrechen stellt Inspektor Nick Cafmeyer (Geert Van Rampelberg) und seine Kollegen vor ein Rätsel. Die brutale Entführung einer Familie und der barbarische Tod ihres Sohnes zeigen Verbindungen zu früheren Fällen. Schon bald macht in der Gegend das Wort von einem unheimlichen 'Troll' die Runde, der kleine Kinder töten soll. Die Ermittlungen bringen Cafmeyer - selbst traumatisiert durch ein lange zurückliegendes, persönliches Schicksal - an seine emotionalen Grenzen. Doch der Albtraum hat gerade erst begonnen.

programme.title: Empire of War
programme.desc: Die berüchtigte Henan-Katastrophe von 1942 bildet den erschütternden Hintergrund für mehrere dramatische Einzelschicksale, mittels derer uns "Empire of War" das Unbegreifliche begreifbar machen will. Denn Dürre, Hungersnot und der Krieg mit Japan haben verheerende Folgen vor allem für die chinesische Bevölkerung, die nicht zuletzt auch zum Opfer einer korrupten und unfähigen Regierung wird.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: The determined Jim Ellis starts a swim team for troubled teens at the Philadelphia Department of Recreation.

programme.title: Wisegal
programme.desc: A widowed mother of two goes to work for her lover Frank Russo, a Captain in a Brooklyn crime family.

programme.title: Denial
programme.desc: A historian must battle to prove the Holocaust actually occurred when a renowned denier sues her for libel.

programme.title: The Pilot's Wife
programme.desc: A recently widowed woman struggles to learn if her husband intentionally crashed the plane he was piloting.

programme.title: Last Chance Harvey
programme.desc: A struggling jingle writer and a lonely bureaucrat meet by chance in London and transform each others' lives.

programme.title: 20th Century Women
programme.desc: In 1979 Santa Barbara, a single mother enlists two women to help with her son's upbringing.

programme.title: A Million Little Pieces
programme.desc: James Frey uncovers a community of recovering addicts that support him on his journey to redemption.

programme.title: Thank You for Your Service
programme.desc: A look at how Post Traumatic Stress Disorder affects American servicemen and women returning home from war.

programme.title: Factory Girl
programme.desc: A wanna-be star meets and falls for Andy Warhol, and he promises her the fame she's always dreamed of.

programme.title: Bang Bang Club
programme.desc: The true-life experiences of four combat photographers capturing the final days of apartheid in South Africa.

programme.title: David's Mother
programme.desc: Sally has managed to keep her autistic son out of "the System", until a social woker comes along.

programme.title: Sands of Oblivion
programme.desc: An archaeologist couple and an Iraq War combat veteran uncover a replica of ancient Egypt made for a movie.

programme.title: Hercules in New York
programme.desc: Banished from Mount Olympus, Hercules is sent to Earth where he finds true love and becomes a bodybuilder.

programme.title: Skyline
programme.desc: Strange lights over Los Angeles herald the arrival of malevolent aliens who threaten to swallow up humanity.

programme.title: Psicopata Americano 2
programme.desc: Situada quase 15 anos após os eventos de American Psycho, esta é a história do único sobrevivente de Patrick Bateman que se torna uma professora assistente de um professor, mesmo enquanto desenvolve suas próprias obsessões assassinas, destruindo qualquer um em seu caminho.

programme.title: Psicopata Americano
programme.desc: Patrick Bateman, um jovem que trabalha em Wall Street na empresa de seu pai, mata sem nenhum motivo. A cada dia, seu ódio pelo mundo se torna mais e mais intenso. Esta comédia incrivelmente sombria é baseada no livro de Bret Easton Ellis.

programme.title: Psicopata Americano 2
programme.desc: Situada quase 15 anos após os eventos de American Psycho, esta é a história do único sobrevivente de Patrick Bateman que se torna uma professora assistente de um professor, mesmo enquanto desenvolve suas próprias obsessões assassinas, destruindo qualquer um em seu caminho.

programme.title: Psicopata Americano
programme.desc: Patrick Bateman, um jovem que trabalha em Wall Street na empresa de seu pai, mata sem nenhum motivo. A cada dia, seu ódio pelo mundo se torna mais e mais intenso. Esta comédia incrivelmente sombria é baseada no livro de Bret Easton Ellis.

programme.title: Os Guardiões
programme.desc: A história é ambientada na Guerra Fria e acompanha um esquadrão de heróis reunidos pela extinta União Soviética. Depois de passar anos escondendo suas identidades, eles terão enfrentar uma perigosa força do passado. Os protagonistas são Khan, que evoca uma entidade para ficar mais veloz e usar espadas; Ler , capaz de controlar pedras; o meio humano e meio urso Arsus; e Xenia, uma mulher com a habilidade de ficar invisível.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.sub-title: O Episódio do Fundo Infantil de Kwandanegaba
programme.desc: Lindsey e Kevin doam para uma instituição de caridade, mas Nick precisa intervir quando a instituição continua pedindo mais e mais dinheiro.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.sub-title: O Episódio do Sucesso de Bilheteria
programme.desc: Nick e Suzanne querem participar de uma estreia de filme com celebridades, mas suas agendas cheias criam complicações.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.desc: Nick retalia após ouvir Suzanne passando informações pessoais para Gigi.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.desc: Certos segredos podem arruinar dois novos romances se vierem à tona.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.sub-title: O Episódio do Seguro de Vida
programme.desc: Nick e Suzanne consideram comprar um seguro de vida.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.desc: Nick descobre que está com a pressão alta e procura maneiras de diminuir o estresse em sua vida.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.desc: Nick espera contratar um homem de voz dourada para trabalhar como narrador; Suzanne perde uma caríssima blusa de cashmere da Gigi.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.desc: Nick ajuda um colega de trabalho a escrever cartas de amor para uma mulher em um site de namoro... mas descobre que é a Gigi.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.sub-title: O Episódio do Roubo de Identidade
programme.desc: A identidade de Nick é roubada por outro homem chamado Nick Kingston-Persons.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.desc: Quando Nick abre um site pornográfico devido a um erro de ortografia, uma colega de trabalho entende mal suas intenções, o que força os funcionários da KAWT a passarem por um "laboratório de sensibilidade".

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.sub-title: O Episódio da Gafe na Noite de Comédia
programme.desc: Sem querer e com o microfone aberto, Nick ofende Harold Bradley, um funcionário de longa data da KAWT, e é forçado a fazer um controle de danos.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.desc: Marilyn namora um homem mais jovem, mas Nick suspeita dos verdadeiros motivos desse novo namorado. Kevin quebra o braço.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.sub-title: O Episódio de Ação de Graças
programme.desc: Amigos e família se reúnem para um jantar de Ação de Graças, mas Suzanne se esquece do peru.

programme.title: Nerve: Um Jogo Sem Regras
programme.desc: A aplicada aluna do ensino médio, Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts), se cansou de viver a vida no marasmo. Quando seus amigos a pressionam para jogar um jogo online chamado Nerve, Vee decide participar de uma consequência, o que parece ser uma diversão inofensiva. Mas quando ela se encontra presa na emoção da competição cheia de adrenalina, o jogo começa a tomar um rumo sinistro.

programme.title: Zeros e Uns
programme.desc: Ethan Hawke e Abel Ferrara unem-se neste thriller realista e tenso que se desenrola em uma noite mortal em Roma, quando um soldado (Hawke) corre para impedir um ataque terrorista iminente.

programme.title: Amityville 3: O Demônio
programme.desc: Um jornalista se muda para a infame casa de Long Island, convencido de que os horríveis contos de carnificina não são nada mais que lendas urbanas. No entanto, ele tem dificuldades para continuar cético quando eventos terríveis começam a ocorrer na casa.

programme.title: Fuga Implacável
programme.desc: Durante a viagem de barco à vela na Espanha, uma família inteira é sequestrada. Agora, um jovem executivo de Wall Street deve confrontar as pessoas responsáveis: agentes da inteligência do governo que buscam recuperar uma pasta misteriosa.

programme.title: Nos Braços de um Assassino

programme.title: The Christmas Apprentice
programme.desc: Riley Thomas (Abigail Hawk) is a rising star at one of the world's most noted holding companies. With Christmas fast approaching, she is sent to the small town of Chestnut, Vermont to evaluate the assets of one of their companies, an outerwear clothing manufacturer. As she begins making plans for liquidation, she hires the company's founder, Nick (Howard Hesseman)-now retired-as her apprentice to help. Of course, everyone assumes she's there to save the company and she keeps her true motives a secret. In the process, she comes to appreciate what the company means to the small town; and she falls in love with its youthful CEO, Wyatt (David O'Donnell). She slowly comes to embrace the small town's values and even helps create a new product line just in time for Christmas. As her priorities change and her love grows, will Riley be able to stand up to her boss, Preston Bullock (Chevy Chase) and save the company she was supposed to destroy?

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 129: El temblor de la mano de Betania.
programme.desc: Betania y Luis Guillermo están preparándose para su primera noche juntos. Betania le acaricia el rostro y en ese momento comienza a temblarle la mano como en la iglesia y en la casa de los Malavé. Le dice a Luis Guillermo que es que el anillo le queda grande y que ella no puede dormir con joyas. Luis Guillermo se da cuenta del temblor. Inés y Robert están dispuestos a descansar. Robert cree que Inés ya lo va a aceptar y ésta le dice que todavía no está preparada. Que se va a su habitación. Robert dice unas cuantas cosas, pero Inés se va. Alfredo le reclama a Marisela que donde estaba. Ella le dice que fue con Flavia a lo de Betania. Alfredo no le cree y le dice que seguramente fue a ver a Diego Andrés.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 130: La terrible noticia de Betania
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo con sorpresa se entera de la terrible noticia de que no solamente Betania no está embarazada sino que sus días ya están contados porque la situación de su mal es terminal y ella está a punto de morir. A Inés, Emperatriz y Betania no las dejan pasar a la presidencia de la disquera y solo la intervención de Asdrúbal lo hace posible y éste le manifiesta a Inés su alegría porque al fin están al frente de la empresa. Mientras que Armando presiona a Robert para que haga valer sus derechos sobre Inés y como su esposo logre hacerse con la presidencia de la empresa para poder disponer nuevamente del dinero y de todo.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 131: Betania Exige Toda la Verdad
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo e Inés están hablando muy angustiados en relación a Betania. Han tenido que comprar las medicinas que el Dr. Anselmi les ordenó comprar. La angustia es que cuando Betania vea las medicinas, va a saber enseguida que su enfermedad es grave. Inés le dice a Luis Guillermo que ella no puede con el dolor que siente al saber que su hermana se va a morir. Que no se atreve ni a verle la cara a Betania. En ese momento Betania entra en la habitación y escucha lo último que dijo su hermana. Entra y les exige que le digan toda la verdad. Se la dicen y comienza Betania a insultarlos por no haberle dicho de una vez que es lo que tenía.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 132: Divorcio, Conflicto y Sospecha de Embarazo
programme.desc: Betania le pide el divorcio a Luis Guillermo pero éste lo rechaza y trata de hacerle comprender que ambos se aman y que se acaban de casar y que no quiere divorciarse y Robert e Inés tratan de convencer a Betania de que no lo haga solo por temor a que Luis Guillermo le tenga lásmita por su enfermedad. Berta llega justo a tiempo para evitar que Carmita le cuente a Diego Andrés lo que sabe sobre Michelle y Alfredo y luego le reclama por el abandono en que Anzola tiene a su sobrina y le hace ver que ella tal vez pudiera tener otro hombre. La llegada a la pensión de Michelle buscando a Alfredo impide que éste intente hacer el amor con Marisela y ambos comienzan a discutir por el embarazo de ella que Alfredo sospecha puede ser suyo, pero Michelle no se atreve a decírselo.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 133: Betania, Marisela y Michelle en la clinica.
programme.desc: Betania está conversando con Inés. Inés trata de disuadirla para que no se opere ya que dicha operación tiene muchos riesgos. Betania le dice que no, que es preferible morirse de una vez y no estar esperando uno o dos meses para hacerlo. Que se va a operar, que esa es su decisión. En el atellier están todos preocupados porque Marisela se desmayó. Comienzan a llamar a una ambulancia y Cheíto dice que se vayan con él. Se van a la clínica y allí se encuentran con Diego Andrés y Michelle. Michelle está para hacerse unos exámenes y comenzar el control de natalidad. El médico revisa a Marisela, y no tiene nada. Le mandan reposo y una dieta. Cuando Michelle entra al consultorio del mismo médico, el le indica que vaya con la enfermera para que le de todos los datos que él ya viene.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Carlos Ernesto tiene una crisis y Leo está ahí para ayudarlo. Lo trasladan al hospital de urgencia. Leo trata de hablar con su padre pero Leonardo no lo escucha. Finalmente Leo logra comunicarse con Jimena y ella acude a la clínica. Agustina finge tener algo importante que hablar con Adolfo y concierta una cita en la empresa a instancias de Jimena. En un descuido de Adolfo, Agustina se roba una tablet. Oriana va a ver a Alejandra para pedirle el examen de embarazo. Alejandra le da de largas y la hace esperar. Maribel se encuentra con Oriana en la fuente de soda de la empresa y esta última le revela que fue Alejandra quien la ayudó con lo del embarazo. María Lucía se pelea con Julio por las críticas de este hacia su hermano. Finalmente María Lucía le confiesa a Sandra su amor por Leo.

programme.title: Episodio 25
programme.desc: Alejandro desconf a de Sol, se enter que ella se ha visto con Madro o en secreto en un cuarto de hotel. Luego de varias discusiones terminan peleando y va en busca de Madro o. Se encuentran y despu s de pelear Heriberto lo amenaza con un arma, Sol llega justo a tiempo para evitar la cat strofe. Los estudios m dicos de Carlucho dan resultados alentadores. Cuando Maricielo se entera se pone furiosa, ella cree que Carlucho ha inventado todo esto de la enfermedad para dar l stima y conquistarla.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Armando tiene arrinconada a Finita y entra Yolanda a entregar unas facturas. Se separan y Armando se va a buscar a Briggite. Fabián está como loco por Solymar. Está con Wilker y este se da cuenta. Llega Yubiri y se pone a hablar con Solymar. Fabián le dice a Wilker que pueden formar un dos pa dos que él tiene plata. Yubiri le pregunta a Solymar que tiene que cambiar la estrategia para enamorar a Juan Diego. Solymar le da algunos consejos que a Yubiri no le gustan.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Carlos Ernesto sigue hospitalizado mientras Leo y su padre se reconcilian. Llega Julio y hay una evidente tensión entre los hermanos. Virginia le confiesa a Felipe el contenido de las cartas de Miguel Ferrándiz: habría un hijo de Rebeca que no es hijo de Leonardo. Oriana recibe el sobre del test de embarazo de manos de Alejandra y Maribel le cuenta a Irene que la licenciada está ayudando a la chica. Luego, Irene y Maribel la confrontan y se da una pelea que Rodrigo llega a detener. Jimena se guarda la tablet robada por Agustina. En la clínica, Leo y Julio se la encuentran y la interrogan. Ella pone excusas y finalmente le pide a Juan Pablo que trate de acceder al contenido. María Lucía le confiesa a Virginia que está enamorada de Leo.

Maricielo procede a arrestar a Sol y el comisario la acusa formalmente de tener tratos extra os con Madro o y tipifica el caso como "crimen pasional". Ana le entrega su renuncia a Reina. Don Eloy se entera de que Alejandro se cas con Sol.

programme.title: Amor Sem Limites
programme.desc: O sofisticado traficante de drogas Sev e sua sensual namorada Maddie (Sophie Turner de Game of Thrones) levam uma vida sem limites. De festas loucas a aventuras movidas a drogas, a vida é boa para o casal até que um amigo de infância aparece do nada e pede ajuda. Esse evento desencadeia uma sequência de acontecimentos irreversíveis que colocam seu amor e suas vidas em risco.

programme.desc: O jovem Jack é um dos três irmãos que cresceram como parte da família O'Brien em uma pequena cidade do Texas. Jack tem um relacionamento controverso com seu pai, mas se dá bem com sua bela mãe. Como adulto, Jack luta com seu passado e tenta dar sentido à sua infância, ao mesmo tempo em que se debate com questões existenciais maiores.

programme.title: Life - Um Retrato de James Dean
programme.desc: Inspirada pela ensaio fotográfico para a revista Life (1995), revela a amizade impossível entre fotógrafo Dennis Stock e um ator pouco conhecido chamado James Dean. Naquele momento Stock tinha 26 anos e, aparece James Dean, uma estrela em ascensão, um homem que vai mudar a cultura popular de ternos pelos jeans e de ídolos de matinê por quebra-cabeças e adolescents rebeldes.

programme.title: Tráfico de Mulheres
programme.desc: Nesta história inspirada em personagens reais, três garotas dos EUA, Nigéria e Índia são traficadas por meio de uma elaborada rede global e escravizadas em um bordel no Texas, e devem juntas tentar uma fuga ousada para retomar sua liberdade.

programme.title: A Verdadeira História de Ned Kelly
programme.desc: Inspirado no best-seller de Peter Carey, este filme coloca em questão toda a mitologia criada ao redor do mito sobre a vida de Ned Kelly, observando o passado de violência de toda uma sociedade. Acompanhamos a juventude de Ned e observamos sua vida até o final, percebendo, sob a ótica do protagonista, o quanto é distorcida a fina linha que separa o certo do errado. As motivações de Kelly são reveladas e as tragédias em torno de sua gangue são mostradas de forma intensa e poderosa, a começar pelo amor de uma mãe por seu filho.

programme.desc: Lily, a museum curator, discovers a painting that looks just like her and is sent to find where the painting came from and who painted it. As she fights to save both her father and Grant's public image, she falls in love and learns not to judge a book by it's cover.

But can Emma and Lily overcome their problems and use their matchmaking skills to bring their divorcing parents back together?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three cruel events in part 1, the World record holder on the deadlift with 501 Kg, will fight for the crown and the title. You simply cant miss this most epic show, at in the World Trade Center in Dubai part 2.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 10, Finland Lightweight World Championship
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 15, Mexico World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 16, Mexico World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 1, Norway - World Strongest Viking
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capichampions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2018 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in history, Strongman Champions League will set up competition in Abu Dhabi. The line-up of super athletes, who are part of the SCL, includes former world champions Dainis Zageris (Latvia) & Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland), current world champion Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and biggest strongman in the World Sean O’Hagan (Ireland).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage six of Strongman champions league, 2018 is set back on north, in Finland. programme.title: The Direction
programme.desc: This week we're joined by our good friend and Worship Leader, Rob Key. A tremendous musical talent that's chased the country music dream, but found his calling as worship leader at Taylorsville Community Church. Rob's love for serving the Lord is his top priority, but he certainly enjoys the great outdoors and especially doing a little fishing.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: After a few incredible days targeting redfish on the inshore waters of Venice, Louisiana, Eric and Moe Newman bring Rush to the nearshore oil rigs — and that’s where things get wild. The rigs are holding GIANT mangrove snapper, bruiser cobia, and hard-fighting jacks… but getting them to the boat is a whole different story. Fishing heavy structure means short strikes, busted hooks, shredded leaders, and fish that know exactly where to run. Around these rigs it’s not just fishing — it’s full-blown combat. If you want to land one of these beasts, you better bring extra hooks, heavy tackle, and a whole lot of patience. Easier said than done. Venice, Louisiana continues to prove why it’s one of the most action-packed fisheries in the country.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 10 is a wrap! Rush takes a moment to look back on some of his favorite moments from battling giant snook and feisty tarpon in Florida, to overnighting at Catalina Island, and chasing bull redfish in Louisiana. This season was all about getting out there with good friends, making new ones, and enjoying the sport we love. An unforgettable year filled with adventure, laughs, and epic days on the water.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: With the local Key West ship wrecks covered in Permit, Rush takes good friend and marine artist KC Scott fishing for "inspiration." While permit is the plan, the boys stay rigged and ready for the numerous species the Florida Keys may deliver when fishing offshore.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The most important fish catch is the one that got you hooked on fishing in the first place, and for many of us that catch happened early in life. On this episode Ali and Rush grab their favorite little fishing buddies for a great day on the water on their respective coasts. In Florida, Rush spends time with his son Kade fishing for huge permit while Ali takes his nephew Duke out for some wholesome yellowtail action in California.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Season 4 of Hunting Land Man is starting off with a bang. In this episode, it’s opening week of turkey season in Mississippi, and these birds are doing it right. Cool mornings, gobbles breaking daylight, and longbeards fired up and on the move. We are fired up for the 2026 turkey season.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade ends the saga with a deer he has watched for a few years, Pope. On a previous episode you saw Slade put in all of the work with feeder and food plot strategy to make the stars align. Make sure you watch that episode as well to see the behind the scenes work it took to bring Pope to 25 yards.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Hunting Land Man keeps it rolling in the Mississippi woods. We’ve got some good buddies in camp this week, and it doesn’t take long for things to get interesting. One hunt ends in a tough miss, but we stay after it and bounce back with a longbeard hitting the dirt not long after. Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode Slade takes Bentley on his very first duck hunt. Slade also gets to take a trip to duck hunting paradise with some great buddies of his. This episode is all about having a great time with great friends.

programme.desc: From Miami to Apalachicola Bay, Florida, Capt. Jonathan Moss revisits some of his favorite moments from this season.

programme.desc: Captains Scott Walker and Steve Rodger take Plantation Boat Mart’s new 36’ Invincible out to the swordfish grounds.

programme.title: Into The Blue
programme.sub-title: "Palm Beach in the new Invincible Catamaran"
programme.desc: Captains Scott Walker and Steve Rodger break in their new Invincible Catamaran with a trip to fish out of Palm Beach with their friend Captain Dave Fields.

programme.title: Into The Blue
programme.desc: Captains Scott Walker and Steve Rodger fly kites with Captain Dave Fields for a great day of sailfishing out of Sailfish Marina in Palm Beach.

programme.title: Into The Blue

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. - - With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: On opening day of Missouri’s gun season, hunters from around the state seek ridges and box blinds throughout the “Show Me” state in search of mature whitetail bucks. For Nikki Boxler and the Winchester Deer Camp, it’s no different. With Winchester’s in hand, Nikki and crew play cat and mouse with several mature bucks at Indian Hill Outfitters in Pike County.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Every season, just like clockwork, mission-driven longboards gobble their way across the plains of South Dakota, the cornfields of Iowa, the timbered ridges of Michigan and the cattle ground of Kansas looking for their soulmates in one of the most celebrated hunting seasons in America…the wild turkey breeding season. Join Team Winchester as they stalk, call, flank and roost boss gobblers into range from coast to coast.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Everything is bigger in Texas, including the stories. With the whitetail rut in the midwest winding down, the Winchester Life Crew of Chris Keefer, Casey Keefer, Nikki Boxler and Paul Sawyer head south to the Texas Panhandle with Winchesters in hand hoping to wrangle in a few Texas-sized giants.

programme.title: Sail Kings
programme.desc: Capt. Jared Raskob joins great friends Mitch Widom, Andy Yaffa, Chris Hamaway, and local Capt. Gonzalo Castillo for an epic day of Mahi fishing just offshore in Los Cabos, Mexico.

programme.title: Sail Kings
programme.desc: Capt. Jared Raskob joins Capt. Eric Reynolds & Jessica Ocasio on a sporty adventure offshore from Islamorada in search of Swordfish.

programme.title: Sail Kings
programme.desc: Capt. Jared Raskob joins the legendary offshore Capt. Scott Stoky for a day of fishing in Islamorada, Florida.

programme.title: Sail Kings
programme.desc: Capt. Jared Raskob joins his long time friends Capt. Tyler Webb and Capt. Casey Yaworski on a hunt for Sails in Islamorada, Florida.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Shotgun sports are experiencing unprecedented growth, with competitions across the country gaining popularity as enthusiasts vie to be the best shooters in the world. Every summer, the Amateur Trapshooting Association hosts The Grand American in Sparta, Illinois. This year marks the 125th Anniversary for the largest trap shooting competition in the world. We’ll talk with the people who make this tournament run behind the scenes and explore what makes this tournament such a special event. We’ll also look at the rich history of The Grand. On-site we’ll chat with the curator of the Trapshooting Hall of Fame and look at some of the incredible historical pieces on display in the museum. Additionally, we’ll learn about White Flyer and how the clay manufacturer has made important innovations for the shotgun sports.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nobody chases the waterfowl migration as hard as Shawn Stahl of Team Winchester. The Michigan native spends over half of his year running the highways and flyways searching for the x. In this episode, we’ll tag along with Shawn and his crew with their Winchester pumps in hand as they hunker down hiding in fields and timber in hopes of locked wings from ducks and geese.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Overview: East Alton, Illinois is the home of Winchester Ammunition and the manufacturing home of the shotshell plants that build and produce millions of rounds of ammo for hunters, sport shooters, military and law enforcement. Get an unprecedented inside look at the birth cycle of a shotshell inside the walls of Winchester. From hull to primer, shot to wad and packaging to shipping, watch how the most legendary and successful ammunition brand in the world comes to is born and built.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.
